title: Study in South Korea
tagline: Language courses, bachelor’s and master’s degrees at Korean universities. GKS and university scholarships.
intro:
South Korea is SelfAcademy’s core destination. We help students from Kyrgyzstan and Central Asia get into Korean language programs and universities, win scholarships and obtain student visas.

We work with admissions to Sejong, Dankook, Woosong, Chungbuk, Jeonbuk, Keimyung and other universities — matching the program to your language level, grades and budget.
services: D-4 / D-2 student visa and pre-departure preparation

sections.heading: Study programs
sections.body:
**Language courses (D-4).** Ideal for beginners. Courses run by semester at university language institutes; afterwards you can enter a bachelor’s program at the same university.

**Bachelor’s.** 4 years. Taught in Korean (usually TOPIK 3 or higher) or in English for some majors.

**Master’s.** 2 years. Many English-taught programs, especially in engineering, IT and business.

sections.heading: Scholarships and discounts
sections.body:
**Global Korea Scholarship (GKS)** is a government scholarship covering tuition, living costs and airfare. Competition is strong, so documents are prepared well in advance.

Many universities also offer **tuition discounts based on TOPIK level** and grades. We will tell you what you can apply for.

sections.heading: Working while studying
sections.body: International students may legally work a limited number of hours per week once they receive permission. It helps with living costs but does not replace financial preparation for the move.

documents: School certificate or diploma with transcript, translated and apostilled
documents_note: Requirements vary by university — we prepare the list for your chosen program.

steps.title: Consultation
steps.text: We assess grades, language and budget and propose 3–5 options.

steps.title: Documents
steps.text: We prepare translations, apostille and the motivation letter.

steps.title: Application
steps.text: We apply and handle correspondence with the university.

steps.title: Admission and payment
steps.text: We receive the Certificate of Admission and invoice.

steps.title: Visa and departure
steps.text: We obtain the D-4 / D-2 visa and prepare you to fly.

faq.q: Can I apply without knowing Korean?
faq.a: Yes — through language courses (D-4) or English-taught bachelor’s and master’s programs.
Ideally 6–9 months before the semester. Applications for the March intake usually close in autumn, for September — in spring.

faq.q: How much does it cost to study in Korea?
faq.a: It depends on the university, city and program. We will find options within your budget and explain available discounts.

seo_description: Study in South Korea for students from Kyrgyzstan: language courses, bachelor’s, master’s, GKS scholarship, D-4 and D-2 visas.
